name: CLI Publish & CI/CD

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    tags:
      - 'v*'
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

permissions:
  contents: read
  packages: write

jobs:
  lint-and-test:
    name: Lint and Test CLI
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          registry-url: 'https://registry.npmjs.org'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run Linting
        run: npm run lint

      - name: Run Unit Tests
        run: npm test

      - name: Upload Test Results
        if: always()
        uses: codecov/test-results-action@v1
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          file: ./test-results/junit.xml

  build-cli:
    name: Build CLI Package
    needs: lint-and-test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build CLI
        run: npm run build

      - name: Upload Build Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: cli-dist
          path: dist/
          retention-days: 1

  publish-npm:
    name: Publish to npm
    needs: build-cli
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          registry-url: 'https://registry.npmjs.org'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build CLI
        run: npm run build

      - name: Publish to npm
        run: npm publish
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}

  doctor-diagnostics-check:
    name: Verify Doctor Diagnostics
    needs: build-cli
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build CLI
        run: npm run build

      - name: Run Doctor Command
        run: node dist/index.js doctor --json > doctor-output.json

      - name: Validate Doctor Output
        run: |
          if [ ! -f doctor-output.json ]; then
            echo "Doctor command failed to produce output"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Doctor diagnostics completed successfully"
          cat doctor-output.json

  search-index-validation:
    name: Validate Search Index
    needs: lint-and-test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Validate Plugin Metadata Count
        run: |
          PLUGIN_COUNT=$(find plugins -name "plugin.json" | wc -l)
          if [ "$PLUGIN_COUNT" -ne 259 ]; then
            echo "Expected 259 plugins, found $PLUGIN_COUNT"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Metadata validation passed: $PLUGIN_COUNT plugins found"

      - name: Test Fuzzy Search Logic
        run: npm run test:search
